name: Startup Bangladesh Limited
eligibility: Not publicly stated; the Fund of Funds track publishes separate eligibility criteria for fund managers.
applicationPath: Apply through the Application for Investment page.
notes: The government's own venture capital company. Also listed in the investor directory — this entry covers the government-funding route into it.

name: iDEA Project, ICT Division
eligibility: Early-stage or newly established ventures for the pre-seed startup grant; small and medium ICT-based entrepreneurs for the SME grant.
amount: Not publicly stated as a fixed tier on the project site.
applicationPath: Apply for the Startup Grant, SME Grant or co-working space through the iDEA portal; an SoP for the startup grant is published.
notes: Innovation Design and Entrepreneurship Academy, run by the ICT Division. States 450+ startups funded. Free co-working space is offered alongside the grants.

name: Bangladesh Bank Startup Fund
type: Central bank refinance scheme, disbursed through banks
eligibility: Startup entrepreneurs borrowing through a scheduled bank; 10% of the fund is reserved for women entrepreneurs.
amount: BDT 5,000 million refinancing revolving fund at Bangladesh Bank, plus separate bank-level funds built from 1% of yearly operating profit (2021–2025).
deadline: Rolling — administered by the lending bank
applicationPath: Apply through a scheduled bank, not Bangladesh Bank directly.
notes: Policy caps the borrower's interest rate at 4%. This is debt, not equity — confirm current terms, security requirements and the bank's own conditions before counting on it.

name: SME Foundation
eligibility: Small and medium enterprises; a separate women entrepreneur development track exists.
applicationPath: Access to Finance credit wholesaling and Business Support Services through smef.gov.bd.
notes: Runs credit wholesaling through partner banks rather than lending directly, plus advisory centres, a women entrepreneurs directory and policy advocacy. Publishes a bank loan checklist and business plan template.

name: Bangladesh Hi-Tech Park Authority (BHTPA)
type: Government authority — parks, incentives and one-stop service
eligibility: IT and ITES companies and investors locating in a hi-tech park.
amount: Not publicly stated; an incentive package is published separately.
applicationPath: Apply through the BHTPA One Stop Service (OSS) portal.
notes: The value here is space, tax and duty incentives rather than cash. Read the published incentive package before assuming any specific exemption applies to you.

name: Bangladesh Small and Cottage Industries Corporation (BSCIC)
type: Government corporation — small and cottage industry
eligibility: Small and cottage industries; district office network handles applications.
applicationPath: BSCIC One Stop Service and district offices.
notes: Runs loan programmes, training, industrial estate plots and published project profiles. Oriented to manufacturing and cottage industry more than to software startups.

name: EDGE Project, Bangladesh Computer Council
type: World Bank and Government of Bangladesh project
applicationPath: Join through edge.gov.bd; a Hire and Train programme application is advertised.
notes: Enhancing Digital Government and Economy — a BCC project under the ICT Division. Offers skills, 4IR and research centres rather than direct startup capital.
